# Lattice | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning | AI-driven talent and performance platform covering performance, objectives, participation, growth and remuneration. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | Not local HRIS/pays; TCO after seating and additional modules; performance rating and AI recommendations must be maintained with manual supervision. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Not local HRIS/remuneration; TCO after seating and additional module; manual supervision of performance ratings and AI recommendations must be maintained. |
